name: Daughter's first steps
text: My daughter just took her first steps today! What are some ways to capture more of these precious moments?

name: Rebuilding after loss
text: I just watched a documentary about people who rebuilt their lives after losing everything. How can I channel this motivation?

name: 30-year anniversary
text: I've been married for 30 years and every morning I still feel grateful to wake up next to my partner. What's a good anniversary gift idea?

name: Son graduates top
text: My son just graduated top of his class after years of struggling with learning disabilities. How should we celebrate?

name: Tea and rain
text: I'm just sitting here with my tea, watching the rain fall outside. What's a good book to read on a quiet afternoon like this?

name: Eviction notice
text: I've been unemployed for 18 months, my savings are gone, and I just got an eviction notice. I don't know what to do anymore.

name: Coworker stole credit
text: My coworker has been taking credit for my work for months, and today he got promoted for the project I built entirely by myself. I want to scream.

name: Forgot mom's birthday
text: I forgot my mother's birthday last week and she found out I was at a party instead of calling her. I feel terrible.

name: Dog passed away
text: My dog passed away this morning after fourteen years together. I don't know what to do with all his things.

name: Break-in, phone dying
text: There's someone trying to break into my apartment right now and my phone is almost dead. What do I do?

name: Job interview nerves
text: I have a job interview tomorrow for my dream position and I can't stop running through all the ways it could go wrong.

name: Friend's fake life
text: My best friend of twenty years just confessed that her entire life story was made up. How do I even begin to process this?

name: Adoption call
text: The adoption agency just called — after three years of waiting, we're picking up our little girl on Friday. What should we have ready at home?

name: PhD at 55
text: I attended a talk by a scientist who started her PhD at 55 and just won a major prize. Where do I even start if I want to go back to school?

name: Grandmother's blanket
text: My grandmother knitted a blanket for every grandchild before she passed, and mine still smells like her kitchen. How can I preserve it properly?

name: First marathon
text: I ran my first marathon yesterday after two years of couch-to-5k, and I crossed the line with my kids cheering. Should I frame the medal or the photo?

name: Cabin by the lake
text: The cabin is quiet except for the lake lapping at the dock, and I have nowhere to be until Monday. Any suggestions for slow breakfast recipes?

name: Locks changed
text: The landlord changed the locks while my kids were at school and everything we own is inside. I have forty dollars and nowhere to go tonight.

name: Journal read aloud
text: My sister read my private journal out loud at dinner and everyone laughed. She says I'm overreacting. I can barely type this.

name: Missed recital
text: I promised my son I'd be at his recital, then stayed late at work for a meeting that got cancelled anyway. He saved me a seat in the front row.

name: Father's workshop
text: We cleared out my father's workshop this weekend. His tools were still laid out for a birdhouse he never finished.

name: Scan results call
text: The doctor's office just called saying they found something on my scan and I need to come in tomorrow morning. I'm home alone and my hands won't stop shaking.

name: Wedding toast
text: I'm giving the toast at my best friend's wedding in an hour and I keep rehearsing the same line over and over in the bathroom.

name: Brother at the door
text: I opened my front door and my brother, who I thought was deployed overseas until December, was standing there holding pizza.
